provenance.kind: Project-authored controlled statistical example. Values are stipulated observations or population working moments as explicitly stated, not new experimental data.
provenance.source_scope: No outside information is required; every inferential assumption is declared.

model: Seven independent latent readings are Normal(mu,1). Four exact values exceed the fixed detection limit0; the other three are known only to be at or below0. The apparatus records every unit, including censored units; this is censoring, not truncation by unrecorded units. Maximize the full observed-data likelihood over -5<=mu<=5. For an uncensored reading its density contributes; each censored unit contributes Phi((0-mu)/1). Do not substitute0 for a censored value. Report the estimated latent mean of a censored unit under the fitted model, mu-phi(mu)/Phi(-mu), separately from the population mu.
precision: Absolute1e-5 is sufficient for fitted means; the likelihood is strictly concave for this fixed positive variance. The normal CDF/density, or an independently accurate numerical equivalent, must be used.
scope: Controlled reporting-limit example in generic measurement units; no scientific extrapolation beyond the stated latent normal model is established.
